text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —There is something wrong with this world.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No one, no one will look this way! Even 
though Windy-chan is so amazing—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah-hah! 
Wah-hah-hah-hah-hah-hah-haaa!

text_block_list.name: Henchmen
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa! It's Lady Windy-chan! Make way! The 
boss is coming through~~! Urgh, what an 
overwhelming aura of evil...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Calm down, I say~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You guys... how are things looking down in 
the mortal realm?

text_block_list.name: Henchman A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There's an uproar because that Shinko 
Windy is debuting in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Drawing massive attention 
already, I see... Excellent...! All 
according to plan.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan's gonna win non-stop in that 
glittering spotlight, and then..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll plunge this world into the depths of 
terror! And reign supreme as the big boss 
of evil that e~veryone fears and 
respects~!

text_block_list.name: Henchmen
text_block_list.text: —Uwoooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna leave a massive bite mark on the 
racing world~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Henchmen
text_block_list.text: —Uooooooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh heh...! That's it, look...! 
Look over here more, even more, I say...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All the eyes in the whole wide world 
belong to the evil mastermind, 
Windy-chan—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Gwah! ...W-Was that a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right! My training with her 
starts today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last, my journey taking on the Twinkle 
Series alongside Shinko Windy begins. 
However...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —ROAAAR—!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyahahahaha! "Pyah!" he says! Mornin' to 
ya, minion!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaping down from a nearby roof with 
powerful legs was Shinko Windy. She seemed 
full of energy from the morning, but...
choice_data_list:
You have to take good care of your legs 
for the races, too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nu! Come to think of it, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It can't be helped... I shall endure it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan's gonna use these legs to tear 
up a whole bunch of races, you bet♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I tell her it's for the sake of the 
race, she listens to my instructions. She 
may be a prankster, but her feelings 
toward the Twinkle Series are genuinely 
real.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's get straight into training!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaaaa~~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy dug her heels into the dirt 
muddied by yesterday's rain and sprinted 
hard. Undeterred by the splattering mud, 
she flew forward...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fuhaa, fuhaa...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Windy-chan, you're covered in mud 
already this morning! Dirt really is 
brutal, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, cool, right~~! This mud is proof 
of being a bad boy~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
P-Proof of a bad girl...? You're really 
not interested in turf, Windy-chan? It's 
the royal road and gets so much attention, 
though~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I found it a bit 
curious. Why someone who 'wants to stand 
out' doesn't race on turf."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turf is the royal road—hugely popular with 
a massive competitor base. Dirt is the 
opposite... It's hard to deny that it has 
a somewhat plain image.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Ununu~~~, turf just feels off. It's way 
too refreshing, not villainous at all!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you think about it, turf is like a 
superhero squad of justice! And dirt is 
like an elite evil secret syndicate!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...That's the gist of it, yes.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's boring doing the same thing 
as everyone else just because it's 
popular, nod.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to stand out by being different," 
is it...? How typical of her contrarian 
nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, her greatest weapon is her 
"power." Dirt is undeniably more suited to 
her than turf.
choice_data_list:
(Whatever the reason, dirt was the right 
call.)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Even on dirt, Windy-chan is totally gonna 
outshine those turf runners!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Seconds on dashes, please! 
There's no time to rest, nanoda!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Shinko Windy devoted herself to 
training. However...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Zzz... mumble mumble...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san! Asleep again? We're in the 
middle of class!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Unyaaah, so loud... Lemme sleep~! I'm 
wiped out from morning practice~!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gahahahahaha!! Take that~!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher B
text_block_list.text: Heeey!! Stooooop that right now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! I'm not gonna stop~!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—Ugyaaaaaaah!! Let go of meee~~! I'll bite 
youuuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're the Trainer in charge of this 
girl, right? Jeez, please do something 
about her. She's constantly causing 
trouble during class and recess alike...!
choice_data_list:
W-Well, let's hear what they have to say 
first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jumping to conclusions won't do! Calming 
down the flustered girl, I asked what was 
going on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Since Shinko Windy was in the wrong, I 
properly disciplined her and apologized 
together with her.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list:
Don't go overboard with the pranks, 
alright?
Don't go overboard with the pranks, okay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph, so there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulling pranks is surely because she 
doesn't know what to do with her 
'overflowing fighting spirit' and 'need 
for approval'... probably.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If we can channel that emotion properly 
into her running, she will undoubtedly 
leave a ferocious bite mark on the racing 
world."
choice_data_list:
People will pay more attention to your 
race than your pranks.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I... I know that! 'Cause Windy-chan is 
strong, after all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll just run a quick lap or two, and 
everyone will be captivated in no time.
choice_data_list: Well then, let's head to training!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... It can't be helped, then! I'll let 
you off the hook with just this prank 
today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has a difficult temperament, but she's 
bound to run wonderfully. I truly believed 
that. For now, let's do our best aiming 
for her debut race.
